artworks.title: The Adoration of the Magi
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.3 × 4.2 cm (2 7/8 × 1 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene showing a group of figures gathered outside a building with columns and a slanted roof. The central focus is on two seated figures, one holding a small child. Various figures are presenting gifts or showing gestures of reverence towards them. The foreground includes additional figures, one playing a musical instrument. The background features an architectural setting with detailed line work, ornamental details, and clothing suggesting a rich, historical context. The style of the drawing is intricate and expressive, using shading and line work to create depth and detail.

artworks.title: The Virgin Presents Jesus at the Temple
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.8 × 4.5 cm (2 11/16 × 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious ceremony in an architectural setting. There are figures gathered around a central figure holding something on a table or altar. The architecture is ornate with columns, sculptural niches, and figures in draped garments. Two sculpted figures are in niches. Large arches and hanging lamps are present. The text "Maria Jesum in templo offert" is written at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7 × 4.2 cm (2 3/4 × 1 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three individuals on a journey with cherubs in the sky overhead. The scene depicts a serene countryside landscape where two figures are riding on a donkey while accompanied by another individual on foot. The donkey is walking along a path flanked by trees. Above them, there are several cherubic figures flying or floating among the clouds. The landscape is rich with intricate linework detailing the trees, rolling hills, and clouds, creating a sense of depth. The lower margin contains the phrase "Maria fugiens in Egiptum" which translates to "Mary fleeing into Egypt."

artworks.title: The Death of the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7 × 4.5 cm (2 3/4 × 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with a figure in a bed surrounded by onlookers, celestial figures, and divine light. The figures are dressed in robes and some are in prayer or contemplation. The central figure appears saintly with a glow or halo. The scene is detailed and conveys a solemn and sacred atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Burial of the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7 × 4.5 cm (2 3/4 × 1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around a resting figure in an enclosed and rocky environment. The setting forms a natural arch above them, adding depth to the image. Heavenly light streams through the rocky arch, illuminating the scene below. Stylized clouds and winged figures are depicted above. The figures surrounding the central lying figure appear engaged in a reverent activity. Some figures have drapery and haloes, adding a sacred tone. The drawing is detailed with lines and shading emphasizing the environment and figures.

artworks.title: The Assumption of the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7 × 4.1 cm (2 3/4 × 1 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene. The image shows figures in flowing robes, with a central figure rising towards a radiant figure in the heavens surrounded by clouds and angelic beings playing musical instruments. Below, figures are shown gazing upwards. The artwork features intricate lines and fine detailing in the cloth and expressions of each figure. The composition captures a moment of divine interaction and contemplation.

artworks.title: Attributes of the Virgin
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7 × 4.1 cm (2 3/4 × 1 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure standing on clouds, positioned centrally. The person appears in a slightly frontal position with arms outstretched, holding open a long cloak. The facial features include a serene expression with long hair. The person is dressed in a flowing gown. Around them are cherubic figures. The background consists of clouds and angelic figures playing musical instruments. Below the clouds, in the foreground, there is a figure on the ground with a landscape that includes trees and distant hills. The scene conveys a sense of elevation, framed with etched lines.

artworks.title: Title Page for "The Military Exercises"
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.3 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate title page. The central focus of the image is a large, detailed text panel framed by decorative elements, including several figures and objects. The panel is filled with elegant calligraphy, reading "EXERCICES MILITAIRES fait par Noble I. Callot Mis en lumiere Par ISRAEL son amy & Dediez" addressed to a nobleman. Surrounding the text are various military and decorative motifs, including two figures blowing trumpets, flags, and a person playing a drum. At the top is a crest with feathers and other ornamental details, which add to the grandeur of the presentation, and at the bottom, it is dated "1635." The drawing shows a strong sense of organization and symmetry in a formal style typical of that time period, suggesting a historical context related to military or noble matters.

artworks.title: Unarmed Drill
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.3 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three full-body illustrations of men in different stances. The left figure is walking, holding a stick, with his head turned slightly. The middle figure stands with legs together and hands on his chest. The right figure leans on a cane or sword, facing left. All wear hats with feathers, long coats, knee-length trousers, and boots. The illustration emphasizes clothing details and posture. The background is plain, with no other objects. There is text in stylized script at the bottom.

artworks.title: Drill with Drums
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.2 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three drummers in a line. The drawing features three figures, each carrying a drum and marching in a line. The figures are wearing wide-brimmed hats and period attire, and they each hold drumsticks. The drawing employs fine lines and has few levels of shading. The simple background emphasizes the figures and their instruments.

artworks.title: Drill with Halberds
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.2 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in elaborate costumes holding spears. The drawing features three figures that are ornately dressed, seemingly set in a historical or fantasy context, each holding long, slender spears or weapons. The attire includes puffed sleeves, decorative hats with feathers, and high boots. The figures are positioned across the image, each in a distinct pose. The background is plain, drawing attention to the detailed attire and the posed stance of the figures. The bottom of the drawing features a scripted phrase.

artworks.title: Drill with the Musket
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.2 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures carrying long staffs. The figures are dressed in historical costumes with wide-brimmed hats adorned with feathers. They are depicted in motion, possibly marching or walking. The drawing showcases details in clothing and posture of the figures with a delicate and precise use of line work.

artworks.title: Drill with the Musket
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.1 × 8.3 cm (2 3/8 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three full-body depictions of individuals who appear to be military figures or soldiers, drawn in a line art style. Each figure is standing upright, with their body facing slightly toward the viewer but with different stances. The person on the left is in profile, facing the right side of the image, and is holding a long pole or staff at an angle across their body. The central figure is facing forward and holding a pole diagonally across the body, dressed in a wide-brimmed hat adorned with a feather, while the facial features appear to be lightly sketched. The third person, on the right, is shown facing forward as well, holding a long staff vertically in their right hand, with a hat similar to those of the other two individuals. All three are dressed in what appears to be period clothing, involving jackets and breeches, and the figures are holding long poles or spears. The background is plain and featureless, with an inscription in the lower area of the image reading "Cum Privile Reg: Israel excudit".

artworks.title: Drill with Raised Pikes
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.3 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: Three soldiers stand in differing poses, holding long spears. They wear historical military attire, including helmets with feathers. The background is plain, with textured paper and inscribed text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Drill with Tilted Pikes
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6 × 8.2 cm (2 3/8 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in poses demonstrating sword fighting techniques. The drawing presents three individuals equipped with long pole weapons. Each figure is depicted in a different stance. The figures are in Elizabethan or Renaissance-style attire, with distinct puffed sleeves, knee-length tunics, and plumed hats. The lines are clean and precise, emphasizing posture and form. Below the figures, there is text in a script. The overall tone of this illustration is educational, possibly intended for martial training purposes.

artworks.title: Taking the Firing Position with the Musket
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.2 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures holding weapons. The image presents three different poses of a figure in period costume. Each figure appears in a distinct stance and holds a weapon. The figures are sketched using fine line work, portraying details of their clothing and hats with feathers. The background is plain, and lines of text are present at the bottom.

artworks.title: Firing the Musket
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.8 × 8.2 cm (2 5/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three soldiers handling muskets in various positions. The drawing illustrates three figures, each engaged in a different action with their muskets. The first figure on the left is holding a musket with a long barrel resting on a support. The middle figure is preparing to fire, standing with legs apart and readying the musket. The figure on the right is shown in the act of firing, smoke emerging from the weapon. All three figures are adorned in period attire, with ornate hats featuring long feathers. The drawing contains text at the bottom, which appears to be a form of Latin inscription.

artworks.title: Preparing to Fire the Cannon
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.1 × 8.3 cm (2 3/8 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a cannon, barrels, cannonballs, figures in conversation, and detailed textures, suggesting a historical or military theme.

artworks.title: Loading the Cannon
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.8 × 8.3 cm (2 5/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a cannon and three figures in historical attire. The cannon is mounted on a wooden carriage with large spoked wheels. Small cannonballs are scattered on the ground next to it. The figures are dressed in period clothing with feathered hats and are near the cannon. The background is minimal, emphasizing the scene of artillery activity. The text at the bottom adds a formal and historical touch.

artworks.title: Firing the Cannon
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6.3 × 8.3 cm (2 1/2 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cannon being fired. The image shows an old-fashioned cannon on a wooden carriage, aimed and firing. Smoke is coming out of the barrel. Two figures stand behind the cannon holding long sticks. Beside them are a small barrel and cannonballs. The drawing is detailed and etched, set against a plain background with an inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Stopping Place
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 12.2 × 23.6 cm (4 13/16 × 9 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a print of a group of people gathered around a rustic, thatched building. The scene captures a busy moment with a variety of characters engaged in different activities. To the left, several people are gathered outside the large wooden barn or structure. Some individuals appear to be involved in a transaction or social interaction, while others are working or carrying goods. A person on horseback is depicted on the right side, wearing flowing garments. They stand next to a large, bare tree that occupies the right side of the print. There is text in the upper-left corner of the print.

artworks.title: The Bohemians Marching: The Vanguard
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within platemark): 12.3 × 23.6 cm (4 13/16 × 9 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This image shows a procession of travelers, some on camels and others on horses. The travelers are in motion, with the animals they are riding and leading as focal points. The figures wear garments with a mix of cultural influences and carry long poles or staffs. The camels and horses are intricately drawn, adding texture and dynamism. In the background, additional figures and animals are visible, providing depth. The drawing is done in fine lines, emphasizing details like drapery and fur. The scene conveys exploration and communication across different lands, as indicated by accompanying French text.

artworks.title: The Bohemians Marching: The Rear Guard
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 12.2 × 23.5 cm (4 13/16 × 9 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group traveling with a horse-drawn cart. The composition captures figures in motion with a horse-drawn cart laden with people and belongings. Details include clothing, fabrics, belongings such as pots, and a simple background.

artworks.title: The Feast of the Bohemians
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.2 × 23.9 cm (4 13/16 × 9 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of an outdoor scene with several individuals engaged in various activities under large trees. Figures are depicted interacting with elements of daily life such as dressing animals, tending to animals, preparing food, conversing, and resting. The scene has a rustic feel and is drawn in intricate line work reminiscent of 17th-century etching style.
